result:
All four round-1 defects are fixed, and I confirmed the fixes are surgical.

## How I checked

I diffed the round-2 sources against my own round-1 snapshot, and separately diffed the *rendered* PDF text. The rendered diff contains the four fixes, the pagination reflow they cause, and the citation renumbering — **and nothing else**. No number, sentence, or line of code elsewhere moved.

**[D1.1] fixed.** Q4 is now **258 words** (was ~347) — 13% over the ~228 target for a single-part 6-pointer, inside the threshold. The cut is exactly the non-load-bearing material I named: the normalisation ablation, the `ln 2` clause, and "so read the table with that spread". What survives is what a grader needs to not read 0.223 as a bug — the 0.174 chance baseline, the five-draw spread, and the PyG-parity check.

**[D1.2] fixed.** The forward `\cite` across the `p2 → p1b` input order resolves cleanly: **0 undefined citations**, rendering as "Schlichtkrull et al. [1]". The master placed the entry first, so References are now in citation order. I checked it against the paper's title page — title and all six authors match in order; ESWC 2018 is right.

**[D1.3] fixed.** Now "Q1–Q3 and Q5 use `train_and_eval` on the social graph; Q4 uses `train_and_eval_hetero` on the three-relation graph" — correct against notebook cells 11 and 27.

**[D1.4] fixed.** Q5 back-references Q4 rather than restating the caveat.

## Regression checks

The five code listings re-extracted from the round-2 files are **byte-identical** to round 1. I re-ran the PyG comparison regardless — GCN 0.0, idempotence 0.0, GAT 0.0, GIN 0.0, R-GCN 4.8e-07, DeepConv vs APPNP 0.0; parameter counts unchanged. Rebuilt from the shipped sources: clean exit, 8 pages, **0 overfull hboxes, 0 undefined refs/cites**, and `pdftotext` of my rebuild is identical to the shipped `main.pdf` — so the delivered PDF is in sync with its sources. Figure, table, cover page unchanged; lint passes.

Q5 stayed at 405 words. That is unchanged from round 1, where I explicitly declined to raise it (four genuine sub-parts → ~348 scaled ceiling, 16% over, under the threshold). I'm not re-litigating it.

One cosmetic note I never raised as a defect: `fancyhdr` wants ~1pt more `\headheight`. All eight page renders show no overlap.

Nothing substantive left. Round 2 appended to `validator/checklist.md`.

VERDICT: PASS
